\section*{Reader's summary}
\addcontentsline{toc}{section}{Reader's summary}

\statusbox{\textbf{Input:} one exact observation-local per-array MAP, JINC,
FLT-FIXED, or FLT-MATCHED signal product; exact parent state and optional
terminal FRUIT ancestry; a valid expected source position; an exact AltAz
tangent boundary; and requested method/use state.\\[0.4em]
\textbf{Output when dependencies are available:} a six-role zero-background
elliptical-Gaussian fit and the measured displacement
$\boldsymbol{\Delta}_{\mathrm{POINT}}=\widehat{\boldsymbol{\mu}}-
\boldsymbol{\mu}_{\mathrm{expected}}$ in arcseconds, with identities, states,
support, uncertainty availability, diagnostics, and named-use facts.\\[0.4em]
\textbf{Current numerical status:} unavailable. The contract does not invent
the missing numerical methods.}

The science is deliberately narrow. A known, isolated, bright Pointing source
is fitted on one specified array map. The useful measurement is where the
processed source appears relative to an authoritative expected position in a
declared physical tangent basis. Search centers and peaks help an algorithm
find a candidate; they do not define the astrometric zero point or establish
that the fitted feature is the intended source.

The same fit also supplies amplitude and effective-shape diagnostics. Their
meaning remains that of the exact processed parent map. Amplitude is not
automatically universal flux. Width and orientation are not automatically an
intrinsic beam. Any use for a pointing correction, photometric transfer, or
telescope/observing QC has a separate policy owner and evaluation.

\section{Why a conditional contract is scientifically useful}\label{sec:rationale}

A mature operation can have a stable scientific purpose while still lacking
a content-bound description of its numerical procedure. In that situation,
inventing a familiar least-squares fit or conventional Gaussian width would
silently replace the operation. SCI-POINT therefore freezes what is known:
the targeted source class, six scientific parameter roles, zero-background
model family, coordinate measurement, parent routes, ownership boundaries,
state semantics, and falsifiable consequences. It leaves the unavailable
objective, weighting, width convention, search details, solver rule, formal
errors, and full-map RMS unavailable.

This separation permits later recovery of three exact methods without
changing the package's primary estimand. It also prevents one missing
diagnostic from erasing a future authorized fit. The compatibility method
controls the fit. The formal-error method controls marginal formal errors and
dependent uses. The full-map-RMS method controls only a descriptive
amplitude/RMS ratio.

\section{Physical interpretation in one sentence}\label{sec:physical}

For one identified source and one exact processed map, fit the approved
elliptical-Gaussian family in the map's physical AltAz tangent metric, establish
that the fitted feature is the source, and report its centroid minus the
authoritative expected position while preserving every parent, method,
response, uncertainty, and use limitation.

\section{Scientific-owner decisions represented}\label{sec:decisions}

This contract implements the closed ODQ-001 through ODQ-009 decisions,
including the ODQ-003A terminal-FRUIT and ODQ-003B coadd distinctions. It
preserves per-array outputs, downstream correction ownership, four explicit
routes without substitution, the six-role zero-background compatibility
family, explicit search/fallback state, independent lifecycle/identifiability/
named-use axes, conditional marginal formal errors, bounded amplitude/shape
claims, and separate policy owners.

No scientific decision remains open inside the generic conditional boundary.
The remaining owner actions are content approvals, not invitations to infer
missing science: approve exact compatibility, formal-error, and full-map-RMS
method records; approve exact numerical route boundary instances; review the
four draft named-use profile identities/mechanics; and separately authorize
fixed/full procedure response or observational bias/accuracy if desired.

This r0.2 revision accepts the targeted SCI-VAL congruence, lifecycle,
product-type, response, displacement-covariance, and source-closure directive.
It introduces no numerical route and performs no new broad POINT derivation.

\section{What later validation would and would not establish}\label{sec:validation-layers}

Contract conformance would show that identities, records, states, equations,
dependencies, and failure behavior match this authority. Representation tests
would show that stored and transformed values preserve those meanings.
Numerical tests could evaluate the predictions only after the relevant method
and route are approved. Observational validation could separately measure
bias, repeatability, coverage, or pointing performance. Production readiness
would additionally require operational, performance, and deployment evidence.
Passing one layer does not establish the next.

\section{Document status and nonclaims}\label{sec:status}

This is the targeted Stage B representation of scientific contract v0.1,
document revision r0.2. It was authored from the exclusive Stage A r0.3
author packet and the owner feedback directive dated 2026-09-03. The shared
common core is the normative scientific source. The rationale explains that
source. The ECS supplies prospective engineering evidence procedure and
authors no independent science. A change to any common-core byte requires a
new binding and document generation. This document claims no implementation
inspection, conformity, numerical
production, response/covariance fidelity, uncertainty coverage, observational
